meta.title: Similar Projects — Research Notes
meta.description: Projects in the Anhalt/Brandenburg/East Germany region with overlapping themes. No cooperations established yet. For research and inspiration only.

projects.name: Coconat — Community and Concentrated Work in Nature
projects.description: Europe's first Workation Retreat. Coworking, coliving, makerspace (COCOLAB), startup hub. On a former estate in the Fläming region. Team retreats, residencies (indie games), community events.
projects.relevance: Closest in geography and spirit. Fläming is mentioned in the books as part of the bike route. Combines work, community, rural setting. More commercially developed — booking, events, startup hub.
projects.distance_from_farm: ~40km (Fläming region, between Wiesenburg and Bad Belzig)

projects.name: COCOLAB Makerspace
projects.description: Open workshop and makers retreat. High-tech workshop, team activities, community events. Compost heating plant. Partnership with SolarPunkNow and FH Potsdam design faculty.
projects.relevance: The maker/craft dimension that Hofwerk also aspires to. Interesting model for workshop space.

projects.name: Wiesenburg/Mark — Kunstbrücke
projects.description: Art and culture bridge in Wiesenburg. The town is mentioned in the books as an alternative train stop. Cultural events, exhibitions in the Fläming region.
projects.relevance: Cultural dimension. Wiesenburg is on the direct route to the farm.

projects.name: Ferropolis — City of Iron
projects.description: Open-air museum and event venue on a former open-cast mining site. Giant excavators as industrial monuments. Hosts festivals (Melt!, Splash!).
projects.relevance: Industrial heritage transformation in the same region. Different scale but similar theme of repurposing abandoned infrastructure.

projects.name: Bauhaus Dessau
projects.description: UNESCO World Heritage. The Bauhaus school's second home. Architecture, design, education. Open workshops, residencies.
projects.relevance: Dessau is the nearest city on the train line (one stop after Jeber-Bergfrieden). Design, education, community — historical parallel to integrating craft and intellectual work.

projects.name: Wörlitzer Gartenreich (Garden Kingdom of Dessau-Wörlitz)
projects.description: UNESCO World Heritage. 18th-century landscape garden. Enlightenment ideals made physical — education through landscape, integration of art and nature.
projects.relevance: Enlightenment-era precedent for integrating learning, nature, and community in the same region. Philosophical kinship.
